headline.caveat: common stock at $23.28/share (~215–217M shares), announced Sep 18, 2025; closed Dec 2025 after FTC clearance

nature_md: NVIDIA purchased $5B of Intel common stock at $23.28/share in a private placement (announced Sep 18, 2025; funded Dec 2025 after US antitrust clearance), becoming one of Intel's largest shareholders. Attached to a product alliance: Intel will build NVIDIA-custom x86 CPUs for NVIDIA's AI-infrastructure platforms and x86 SoCs integrating NVIDIA RTX GPU chiplets for PCs, connected via NVLink. Sits alongside the US government's $8.9B/~10% stake and SoftBank's $2B in Intel's 2025 recapitalization-by-strategic-investors. Note: the position's market value has moved well above cost with Intel's share price; press claims about the 'value' of the stake vary — the 13F-marked figure (~$9.5B) is mark-to-market, not new investment.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Marketable equity security on NVIDIA's balance sheet, marked through other income each quarter (as with its Arm holding). Not revenue-linked directly, though the alliance routes future Intel-built CPUs into NVIDIA systems.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity issuance — balance-sheet cash for Intel's foundry/turnaround, no revenue recognized. Dilutive to existing holders; strategically an anchor endorsement of Intel's x86 relevance in AI systems.

events.title: NVIDIA announces $5B Intel investment plus chip co-development alliance
